brief.header.title: Daily brief · {date} ({weekday}) {time}
brief.banner.late: ⚠ This run is {hours}h later than its {slot} slot; activity windows were recomputed against the real time.
brief.banner.stale: ⚠ **This brief has not been updated in {days} days.**
brief.banner.backlog_full: ⚠ The backlog is at its hard ceiling of {max}. **Nothing new may be created today.** Run `{command}` and clear some out.
brief.section.next_actions: Do these first (across the portfolio, not a few per project)
brief.section.decision_pending: Awaiting a decision (not procrastination — missing evidence)
brief.section.stalled: Stalled (no next step) — the column GTD cares about most
brief.section.agent_queue: What an agent could do for you tonight
brief.action.non_goal_flag: ⚠ Looks like it crosses a declared non-goal: {non_goal}
brief.v0_note: *(v0: nothing has interpreted this yet, so what follows is deterministic fact only. Run `{command}` to get "what to do next".)*
brief.next.decision: **Go get the evidence that answers it** (below)
brief.stalled.uncommitted: **{name}** — {count} uncommitted change(s) left sitting there. Either commit them and name a next step, or move the tier to dormant so it stops showing up.
brief.stalled.generic: **{name}** — {extra}Give it a concrete next step, or archive it on purpose.
brief.automation.summary: Of {total} open: **{hook} hookable**, {skill} at the skill layer (one human step left), {explore} still exploratory, {unknown} unassessed; **{human_perm} need credentials or authorisation and will always be yours to do**.
evidence.caveat_mtime: *file timestamps; no git in this repo*
reminder.dropped_claims: ⚠ **Dropped {count} claim(s)** whose evidence would not check out (see `{path}`).
reminder.write_gate_no_git: ⚠ **The write-permission gate did not run: no git binary found.** Nothing was checked for out-of-bounds edits today (see `{path}`).
reminder.write_gate_no_repo: ⚠ **The write-permission gate did not run: the workspace is not inside a git repository.** With no baseline there is nothing to revert against (see `{path}`).
reminder.write_gate_no_commits: ⚠ The write-permission gate did not run: the repository has no commits yet, so there is no baseline to compare against.
reminder.empty_backlog: **The backlog is still empty** — run `{command}` once to pull in the blockers your project documents already describe. Until then the "next step" column is guesswork.
reminder.no_git: ⚠ No git in: {projects} — progress there can only come from file timestamps, and **a bad delete is unrecoverable**.
reminder.conflict: `{doc}` and `{other}` contradict each other about "{about}" — the registry rules in favour of `{winner}`.
reminder.stale_docs: Status documents gone stale: {count}. The oldest: {items}.
brief.truncated: ⚠ The brief ran past its {max}-line ceiling; {lines} lines were cut. The full data is in `{path}`.
brief.footer: *Generated by `{generator}` at {time}. Every claim here passed the evidence gate; whatever could not be verified was not rendered.*
log.counts: open: {open} · awaiting a decision: {decisions} · stalled: {stalled} · neglected: {neglected}
notify.title: nextbrief · daily brief
html.header.title: Daily brief · {date} ({weekday})
html.banner.late: This run is {hours}h later than its {slot} slot; activity windows were recomputed against the real time.
html.banner.dropped: **Dropped {count} claim(s)** whose evidence would not check out; they are not shown. See `{path}`.
html.note.next_actions: Ranked across the whole portfolio, not a few picked from each project.
html.section.agent_queue: What an agent could do for you tonight
html.note.agent_queue: Open one to see what it can do and what is left for you. `{command}` opens a session in the right directory with the context already loaded.
html.note.decision_pending: This is not procrastination, it is a missing judgement. What follows is **the evidence that would settle it**.
html.note.unconfirmed: These were drafted **for you** out of your own project documents, and you have not signed off on them yet. Confirming (`{confirm}`) means "this is real, and it says what I meant" — after that, automatic decay never touches it. Leaving one unconfirmed loses nothing; it just sinks in the ranking over time. If it is wrong, `{drop}`.
html.next.decision: Go get the evidence that answers it
html.footer.same_data: Generated by `{generator}` at {time}, from the same data as `BRIEF.md` — the two cannot drift apart.
html.footer.evidence_gate: Every claim passed the evidence gate: anything whose source does not resolve in `snapshot.json` was never rendered.
tier.hook.label: Hookable
tier.hook.why: the steps are identical every time — worth freezing into a deterministic script
tier.skill.label: Skill layer
tier.skill.why: steps are stable but the judgement moves — write it as a reusable skill
tier.explore.label: Needs a probe
tier.explore.why: the unknowns are not mapped yet — run the cheapest experiment first
